text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon has magnificently run 
through the GⅠ race, the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. The results aren't bad. They 
weren't bad at all. Much of it aligned 
with the experimental tests, preparations 
were made in time, and the results bore 
fruit—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However... actually experiencing it 
firsthand has opened my eyes to so much. 
At this rate—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Ah, Trainer-kun. No, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I've run both the Yayoi 
Sho and the Satsuki Sho. I've fulfilled my 
promise.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, regarding future 
Classic races—
choice_data_list: Next is the Japanese Derby, right!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I figured you would say that. I know 
that full well. However—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Let's leave next time depending on how 
things go for me. Plan A is beginning to 
look a bit clouded, you see."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's... nothing for you to worry 
about. Please don't pay it any mind."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Either way, I can't make any promises 
about running yet. Understood?"

For some reason, her tone was a bit more 
assertive than usual.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Now then. More importantly, time is 
finite! I must hurry back and continue my 
research! Especially now that I've 
gathered data on my rivals.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...This is the perfect chance to pivot to 
Plan B.
choice_data_list:
(...Did she start some new research or 
something?)

(...I wonder if she's started some new 
research?)

text_block_list.text:
As she walks off ahead by herself, I can't 
tell what her true feelings are.

For now, I intend to enter the Japanese 
Derby, but—
